notes.title: v0.8.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have made the following changes to improve the overal experience of the game, based on user feedback and reviews.


 Significantly reduced the amount of flickering lights for a more comfortable experience.
 Unseen Chase Scene has been made slightly easier.
 Adjusted the rotation of the menu interaction raycasts.
 Reduced fuzziness from teddy vignette when it's small.
 Language select now has a confirmation prompt.
 Recentering is now possible through the pause menu.
 Holding the pause button now also allows for a quick-recenter.
 Build version now shows up in main and pause menu
